name: analytics
description: Analytical workload over the pqgen datasets (scale 1m). The task named benchmarks/workloads/analytics.json, which is not present in the workspace; this file is the engine's own definition of that workload (see README, 'Latency optimization').

queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tx WHERE amount > 1000 AND status = 'approved'
SELECT category, COUNT(*), SUM(amount), AVG(fee), MIN(ts), MAX(ts) FROM tx GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS s FROM tx GROUP BY customer_id
SELECT c.segment, COUNT(*), SUM(t.amount) FROM tx t JOIN cust c ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY c.segment
SELECT tx_id, amount FROM tx WHERE status = 'approved' ORDER BY amount DESC, tx_id LIMIT 10

SELECT p.category, SUM(i.quantity * i.unit_price) AS revenue FROM items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id WHERE o.status = 'delivered' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue DESC
SELECT SUM(amount * 2 + fee), COUNT(*) FROM tx WHERE bucket < 500
SELECT YEAR(ts) AS y, MONTH(ts) AS m, COUNT(*), SUM(amount) FROM tx WHERE status = 'approved' GROUP BY YEAR(ts), MONTH(ts) ORDER BY y, m
SELECT category, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) FROM tx GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS s FROM tx GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY s DESC, customer_id LIMIT 20
SELECT merchant_id, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(fee) FROM tx GROUP BY merchant_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 125 ORDER BY n DESC, merchant_id
SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(item_count) FROM orders WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cust WHERE segment = 'enterprise')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cust c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'cancelled')

WITH ov AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity * unit_price) AS v FROM items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT o.status, COUNT(*), AVG(ov.v) FROM ov JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ov.order_id GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status
SELECT o.status, COUNT(i.order_id) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN items i ON i.order_id = o.order_id AND i.quantity > 8 GROUP BY o.status ORDER BY o.status
SELECT sensor_id, COUNT(*), AVG(temperature), MAX(humidity), MIN(pressure) FROM sensors WHERE status = 'ok' GROUP BY sensor_id ORDER BY sensor_id

SELECT CASE WHEN amount < 100 THEN 'small' WHEN amount < 1000 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'large' END AS size, COUNT(*), SUM(fee) FROM tx GROUP BY CASE WHEN amount < 100 THEN 'small' WHEN amount < 1000 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'large' END ORDER BY size
SELECT country, COUNT(*) FROM cust WHERE email LIKE '%7@example.com' AND is_active GROUP BY country ORDER BY country
SELECT s70, COUNT(*), COUNT(n50), SUM(n90), AVG(f95) FROM nh GROUP BY s70 ORDER BY s70
SELECT id, float_key FROM sk ORDER BY float_key, id LIMIT 100 OFFSET 5000
SELECT tx_id, amount, fee FROM tx WHERE status = 'approved' AND amount > 5000
SELECT DISTINCT country, segment FROM cust ORDER BY country, segment
